fusions.name: Silver Skein
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted net at the first enemy it meets that deals 28 damage and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Every other enemy within 3 tiles of it takes 80% of that damage.

fusions.name: Darting Links
fusions.desc: Whirls a ring of links around you that deals 6 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, and each hit darts on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Wriggle Free
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 control conditions from you, and you move 25% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Counter-Current
fusions.desc: Each blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 5% faster per stack, 23% in all at 5 stacks, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
